facts.fact: 自制 tether：晨出暮归 Anne 家（偷来的时辰）——「I am encaged within his arms, and it is a prison I would not fight my way out of.」
facts.anchor: a prison I would not fight my way out of.

facts.fact: 夜宿母亲坟上（数周）：「She is my shadow, a mad reflection of myself, and I am not whole without her. It is a terrible, terrible thought」
facts.anchor: She is my shadow, a mad reflection of myself

facts.fact: 拖 Ladies 尸体过桥扔沟（雨来水涨尸没）；「Rats gather at my feet, constant companions」；「It feels like my mother.」（寒入骨=母亲）
求继续探望 Anne 被斥（spoiled little girl / I never coddled you）——「I would never ask anything again, if you allow me to continue these visits.」全面投降
母亲靠气味推断 Anne 有孕：「A babe must come. Will it be spring? Like a newborn lamb?」「You were mine.」「And still, I am.」
facts.anchor: “She fucks her husband, does she not?”

facts.fact: 黑泪忏悔独白：「You were a light that did not scorch, but warmed. I have so few regrets, child, but your suffering is one I will carry...I will allow that regret to drag me into hell.」
facts.anchor: you were a rare light, one I had long forgotten could even exist

facts.fact: 「Please do not hurt Anne. Not her.」「If not Anne, then whom?」——她愿卖身百次千次转移母亲目光
facts.anchor: I will whore myself out a hundred…a thousand times

facts.fact: 干涸护城河=母亲的心：「Like pieces of my heart, it has cracks, child, fissures split by you and your cruelty, your desire to leave me.」
facts.anchor: Like pieces of my heart, it has cracks

facts.fact: 「You do not love me as you once did...Someone else has claimed a larger part of it, leaving me with scraps.」——「The moat is dry, my darling girl. And I will be your suffering.」→ Oren.「She knows, she knows, she knows.」「I have nowhere left.」
